best_idea: A party or target frame whose HP bar is current over max scaled to a fixed pixel width, with one status outline chosen by fixed priority and a 200 ms hit flash that always runs to the latest hit.
decision_why: Take the bar scaling, the outline priority and the timed hit flash; fix the overlapping-hit defect (one clear event per hit cuts a later flash short) and do not port the five layout modes, since Frankendom wants one layout for now.
acceptance: At 375 px wide in a 3-on-1 fight each party frame shows a 32 px red HP bar that empties as HP falls, and a red outline lasts 200 ms after a hit; a server test asserts hit events at t=0 and t=100 keep the client hit state true at t=299 and false at t=300.
